fact: The trade, transport, industry and tourism ministry published its sectoral statistical yearbook, edition 2024 (figures for 2024), in January 2026, tabulating licences, permits, import-export documents, port and airport traffic and revenue from the ministry's own records.

The education ministry's planning and statistics bureau (BPSE) published the education statistical yearbook 2024-2025, Tome 2 (post-fundamental, technical and vocational schools, data at 15 November 2024), in December 2025, compiled from the annual school census.

INSBU published the 86th national statistical yearbook, edition 2023 (22 chapters, reference year 2023), in December 2024, a compilation of figures drawn from ministries' annual reports and other state services.

The Ministry of Public Health published its Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2024 in August 2025 (figures for 2024), compiled from monthly reports of health facilities and community health groups entered in the national DHIS2 health information system.

The Ministry's health information directorate states it produces a health statistics yearbook every year; the 2024 edition was published in August 2025 after validation by the statistical information technical committee (CTIS) and follows a 2023 edition.
